notes: Sample questions in the canonical shape LANE-INTAKE's bank uses. Wording here proves the renderer only; the bank owns the real text.

questions.text: Which of your brand colours is the MAIN one? It is the colour people should remember you by.
questions.why: It goes on your buttons and headlines, so every page looks like you.

questions.text: Do you have brand fonts you want on your pages?
questions.why: Fonts are a big part of how a page feels.

questions.text: What is the price of your main offer?
questions.why: Buyers see this number, so it has to come from you.

questions.text: Which look do you like best?
questions.why: It sets the mood of every page.
